camel_example: aliyun sddp DescribeInstances --region cn-hangzhou --FeatureType 1 --ServiceRegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --PageSize 10 --ProductCode RDS --CurrentPage 1 --RuleId 1111111 --Lang zh_cn --ProductId 1 --RiskLevelId 2 --Name data
description_en: Retrieves the list of data asset instances for authorized MaxCompute, ApsaraDB RDS, and OSS connections
description_zh: 获取连接授权的MaxCompute、RDS、OSS数据资产实例列表
kebab_example: aliyun sddp describe-instances --lang zh_cn --name data --product-id 1 --risk-level-id 2 --rule-id 1111111 --service-region-id cn-hangzhou --feature-type 1 --product-code RDS --page-size 10 --current-page 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstances

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Default value: zh_cn. Valid values:

zh_cn: Chinese (Simplified).
en_us: English (US)
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh_cn。
取值：

zh_cn：中文（简体）
en_us：英文（美国）
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The search keyword. Fuzzy match is supported. For example, if you enter data, all data entries that contain data in the search item are returned
parameters.help_zh: 设置搜索的关键词，支持模糊匹配。例如，输入data，会搜索出搜索项中包含data的全部数据信息
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the product to which the data asset instance belongs. You can call the [DescribeDataAssets](~~DescribeDataAssets~~) operation to obtain the product ID
parameters.help_zh: 设置数据资产实例所属产品的ID。您可以通过调用[DescribeDataAssets](~~DescribeDataAssets~~)接口获取产品ID
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en:
The risk level ID of the data asset instance. A higher risk level ID indicates more sensitive data is detected. Valid values:

1: No sensitive data is detected. No risk.
2: Sensitive data risk at level 1.
3: Sensitive data risk at level 2.
4: Sensitive data risk at level 3.
5: Sensitive data risk at level 4.
6: Sensitive data risk at level 5.
7: Sensitive data risk at level 6.
8: Sensitive data risk at level 7.
9: Sensitive data risk at level 8.
10: Sensitive data risk at level 9.
11: Sensitive data risk at level 10
parameters.help_zh:
设置数据资产实例的风险等级ID。风险等级ID越高，表示识别出的数据越敏感。取值：

1：表示未识别到敏感数据，无风险。
2：表示1级敏感数据风险。
3：表示2级敏感数据风险。
4：表示3级敏感数据风险。
5：表示4级敏感数据风险。
6：表示5级敏感数据风险。
7：表示6级敏感数据风险。
8：表示7级敏感数据风险。
9：表示8级敏感数据风险。
10：表示9级敏感数据风险。
11：表示10级敏感数据风险
parameters.name: risk_level_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the sensitive data detection rule that the data asset instance hits. You can call the [DescribeRules](~~DescribeRules~~) operation and obtain the rule ID from the Id response parameter
parameters.help_zh: 设置数据资产实例命中的敏感数据识别规则ID。该敏感数据识别规则的ID可调用[DescribeRules](~~DescribeRules~~)接口，查看返回参数Id获取
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en: The region of the data asset instance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/214257.html
parameters.help_zh: 设置数据资产实例的地域。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/214257.html
parameters.name: service_region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the product to which the data asset instance belongs, such as MaxCompute, OSS, or RDS. For supported product names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212906.html
parameters.help_zh: 设置数据资产实例所属产品的名称，包括MaxCompute、OSS、RDS等。关于支持的产品名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212906.html
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of data asset instances to return on each page in a paged query. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置列表中每页显示的数据资产实例的最大条数。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in a paged query. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。默认值：1
parameters.name: current_page

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the current page

Items.description_en: The details of the data asset instances returned
Items.description_zh: 查询到的数据资产实例详情

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the data asset instance was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
CreationTime.description_zh: 创建该数据资产实例的时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒

DepartName.description_en: The name of the department to which the data asset instance belongs
DepartName.description_zh: 数据资产实例所属部门的名称

Id.description_en: The unique ID of the data asset instance recorded in Data Security Center
Id.description_zh: 数据安全中心服务中记录的数据资产实例的唯一标识ID

InstanceDescription.description_en: The description of the data asset instance
InstanceDescription.description_zh: 数据资产实例的描述信息

Labelsec.description_en:
The security status of the data asset instance. Valid values:

true: Secure.
false: Not secure
Labelsec.description_zh:
数据资产实例的安全状态。取值：

true：安全
false：非安全

LastFinishTime.description_en: The time when the most recent scan of the data asset instance was completed. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds

MemberAliUid.description_en: If the management account has enabled multi-account management and the asset belongs to another member account, this field displays the UID of the member account

ProductCode.description_zh: 数据资产实例所属产品的名称，包括MaxCompute、OSS、RDS等。关于支持的具体产品名称，请参见[支持识别敏感数据的数据类型]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212906.html）

ProductId.description_en: The ID of the product to which the data asset instance belongs
